summary: Arm 1 r2b2_nfturn running (warm, incumbent + frontier-focused novel rows + new --respawn-novel-turn 90). Analysis: the field's route past 28.6% (window -> shaft -> tunnel) is physically closed (best 28.74-28.79%); the WR demo (analysis only) shows the real route dips ~2,000 u into a cavity under the pit slab and surfs a ramp there to climb back into the tunnel level. Frontier-focused novel settings put ~20% of novel rows in that cavity (vs 3.8%).
